summary: CBAK Energy filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on October 5, 2026 Nasdaq confirmed the company regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the US$1.00 minimum bid price requirement. The deficiency notice was issued April 30, 2026; the cure was achieved because closing bids stayed at or above US$1.00 for 13 consecutive business days from September 16 to October 2, 2026. Ordinares substituted for common stock on June 24, 2026 after redomiciliation and continue trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market as CBAT. No terms, advisors, or board recommendation are stated; the matter is closed. Watch for renewed sub-US$1 pressure and future deficiency risk.
